title: A monkey accidentally spreads an ember
action: Begin at the supplied first frame with the monkey distracted by its banana and the tiny glowing twig still on the log. During0.5–1.5s the monkey absentmindedly sweeps its single tail once; the tail brushes only the cool dark rear end of the twig and accidentally knocks that one twig off the low log into the adjacent dry leaves. Show an uninterrupted short fall and ground contact, without teleporting or changing the twig count. The existing ember contacts the leaves, a little smoke appears, then one small flame catches at that contact around2.2s. The monkey notices it, draws its tail back, pulls the same banana toward its chest and leans its upper body a little away in one surprised reaction by3.0s. Keep its supported seated lower body, anatomy and banana consistent. Hold the readable surprised pose through5s with only a quiet natural blink and small attached fire flicker. Keep the fire small and the monkey unhurt. This is an imagined comic accident with an existing natural ember, not a claim that this monkey invented fire.
